architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Within CAP-002, SVC-006 may call SVC-005 directly (synchronous same-capability API). SVC-006 and SVC-005 are promoted sub-capability peers within CAP-002.

services.role_in_journey: Primary owner of JRN-013. Creates and manages LetterOfCredit (ENT-036), LCAmendment (ENT-037), TradeDocument (ENT-038), and DocumentExamination (ENT-039). Orchestrates all six phases of the LC lifecycle. Enforces UCP 600 examination deadlines. Triggers cross-capability compliance screening (→ SVC-051 via event) and SWIFT messaging (→ SVC-010 via event).

consumed_events.name: LCComplianceCleared
consumed_events.purpose: PH-054: Gates LC issuance. SVC-006 transitions LetterOfCredit.compliance_status = cleared on receipt. Will not proceed to PH-055 issuance without this event. Idempotent on screening_request_id.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (direct API — same-capability permitted, both in CAP-002)
endpoints: GET /business-customers/{id} — PH-052: read BusinessCustomer to validate applicant status
GET /business-accounts/{id} — PH-053: read facility headroom and account status
POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit — PH-058: debit settlement amount from applicant BusinessAccount on LC settlement
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-006 is the promoted sub-capability peer of SVC-005 within CAP-002. Same-capability direct API calls permitted per architectural principle. SVC-006 holds no local copy of BusinessCustomer or BusinessAccount entity data — all reads go to SVC-005 at runtime.

Trade document PDFs and images (bills of lading, commercial invoices, insurance certificates) are stored in SVC-054. SVC-006 stores only metadata and storage references in ENT-038. SVC-054 is a cross-cutting service accessible to all domain services.

Customer notifications at key lifecycle stages: LC application acknowledgement (PH-052), compliance hold notification (PH-054 EXC-001), LC issuance confirmation (PH-055), document receipt acknowledgement (PH-056), examination result notification (PH-057), settlement confirmation (PH-058), expiry notification (EXC-002).

design_decisions: SVC-006 is the aggregate root owner for all LC lifecycle entities. It enforces the UCP 600 examination deadline as a hard system constraint using a scheduled deadline monitor.
SVC-006 does NOT call SVC-051 synchronously for sanctions screening. It publishes EVT-076 (cross-capability event) and gates PH-055 issuance on receipt of EVT-077 from SVC-051.
SVC-006 does NOT call SVC-010 synchronously for SWIFT messaging. It publishes EVT-078 (LCIssued) and EVT-081 (LCSettled) which SVC-010 consumes to transmit SWIFT messages.

services.role_in_journey: JRN-013 additions to existing SVC-005. Provides facility headroom data and account debit for LC settlement. Called synchronously by SVC-006 (same-capability). Publishes no new events unique to JRN-013 but updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count on EVT-075 and releases headroom on EVT-082.

consumed_events.name: LCApplicationSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-013 PH-052: Updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count. Triggers preliminary facility headroom pre-check.

consumed_events.name: LCExpired
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-013 EXC-002: Releases lc_amount from blocked facility headroom, restoring it to the customer's available trade finance limit. Updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count.

design_decisions: The account debit at PH-058 settlement is implemented as a synchronous POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit call from SVC-006 to SVC-005. This call must succeed before SVC-006 publishes EVT-081 (LCSettled) to trigger SVC-010 SWIFT reimbursement — ensuring atomicity of the account debit and SWIFT instruction.

services.role_in_journey: Performs sanctions and export control screening in PH-054. Consumes EVT-076 (cross-capability) and publishes EVT-077 (cross-capability) on clearance. Never called synchronously by SVC-006.

consumed_events.name: LCComplianceScreeningRequested
consumed_events.purpose: PH-054: Triggers full beneficiary sanctions screening (OFSI, OFAC, UN), HS tariff code dual-use export control check, and TBML typology assessment. Publishes EVT-077 on all-clear.

design_decisions: SVC-051 owns the consolidated sanctions screening capability across all journeys (JRN-009, JRN-013, and others). For trade finance, the EVT-076/EVT-077 pair extends the existing pattern used in JRN-009 (TransferSanctionsScreeningRequested / TransferSanctionsScreened) with a trade-finance-specific payload including HS tariff codes.

services.role_in_journey: Transmits SWIFT messages on behalf of SVC-006. Consumes EVT-078 (LCIssued) to send SWIFT MT700 to advising bank. Consumes EVT-081 (LCSettled) to send SWIFT MT202 reimbursement to correspondent bank. Never called synchronously by SVC-006.

consumed_events.name: LCIssued
consumed_events.purpose: PH-055: SVC-010 transmits SWIFT MT700 (Issue of Documentary Credit) to advising bank SWIFT BIC. Confirms delivery back to SVC-006 via SWIFT delivery receipt. For ETDA e-LC issuance: transmits supplementary SWIFT MT710.

consumed_events.name: LCSettled
consumed_events.purpose: PH-058: SVC-010 transmits SWIFT MT202 (General Financial Institution Transfer) or MT910 reimbursement instruction to advising/reimbursing bank for payment to beneficiary. Deduplication on lc_id + settlement_date + settlement_amount.

design_decisions: SVC-010 acts as the SWIFT messaging adapter for SVC-006. SVC-006 defines the business terms; SVC-010 owns the SWIFT protocol formatting and transmission. This separation means SWIFT network changes (CBPR+ ISO 20022 MX migration, mandatory November 2025) are contained to SVC-010 without requiring changes to SVC-006.

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: Same-capability direct API call. SVC-006 reads BusinessCustomer and BusinessAccount from SVC-005 at application (PH-052) and facility check (PH-053). At settlement (PH-058), SVC-006 calls SVC-005 to debit the applicant's BusinessAccount before publishing LCSettled event to SVC-010.

Cross-capability async event only. SVC-006 publishes EVT-076 (LCComplianceScreeningRequested) to SVC-102. SVC-051 (CAP-005) consumes it. SVC-006 awaits EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared) before proceeding to PH-055.
cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: required — CAP-002 → CAP-005 boundary; no synchronous calls permitted

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: SVC-051 publishes EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared) after successful screening. SVC-006 consumes this event to gate LC issuance.
Cross-capability async event only. EVT-078 (LCIssued) triggers SVC-010 to transmit SWIFT MT700. EVT-081 (LCSettled) triggers SVC-010 to transmit SWIFT MT202 reimbursement instruction.
cross_service_interaction_summary.pattern: required — CAP-002 → CAP-003 boundary; no synchronous calls permitted
